question:
In July 2020, which state initiated the 'Ashirwad Scheme' to extend financial support for a daughter's marriage who belongs

to a family earning a lower income?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Ashirwad Scheme' was launched by the state of Punjab.
 
• The scheme aims to extend financial support for the marriage of daughters belonging to low-income families.
 
• Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the families to help cover the expenses of their daughter's marriage.
 
• It reflects the Punjab government's commitment to social welfare and support for financially weaker sections of the society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashirwad Scheme**

 
 
• The Ashirwad Scheme is a state government initiative aimed at providing financial aid for the marriage of daughters from economically weaker families.
 
• This scheme is designed to alleviate the financial burden on families during marriages, ensuring that daughters receive a dignified and respectful wedding.
 
• The scheme reflects the government's focus on gender equality and support for women's rights.
 
• By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to prevent families from falling into debt due to marriage expenses.
 
 
 
• **Other Similar Schemes**
 
 
• **Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana (Bihar)**
 
 
• Launched by the Bihar government to provide financial assistance for the marriage of daughters from economically weaker sections.
 
• The scheme offers financial aid to ensure that the marriage ceremonies are conducted with respect and dignity.
 
 
 
• **Kanya Vivah Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)**
 
 
• Similar to the schemes in Punjab and Bihar, Uttar Pradesh also has a scheme to support the marriage of daughters from low-income families.
 
• Financial assistance is provided to help families cover the expenses of marriage ceremonies.
 
 
 
• **Balika Samridhi Yojana**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India, this scheme aims at the upliftment of girl children from economically weaker sections.
 
• It provides financial incentives for the education and marriage of girl children to ensure their well-being and development.
